text: Press any key. Even you can manage that.
Dripping on my deck. Wipe your everything.
Hands on the helm. Touch nothing else.
Going down. Try not to enjoy it. Billable.
No deeper. Below this, the hull folds like your resume.
Parked. Nothing out there but money and teeth.
Twilight zone. Sunlight is not included.
Midnight zone. If the lamp dies, so do you.
Standing around? The console exists. Use it.
Dry, warm, and still unprofitable. Impressive.
Still alive? Blink if somehow yes.
Hull upgraded. We go deeper. You go first.
Hull damage. Add it to your tab.
Dry again. First useful thing you have done.
Swim with the stick. Try not to drown.
Point and click to grab. Toddlers manage.
Hold the winch key. It is loud. Deal.
Lamp follows the mouse. Monsters hate it.
Hold cut to be cut loose. Pearls await.
Tether secured. Try to be worth the rope.
First piece. I take my cut. Always.
Pocket change. Retire early, champ.
A bottle cap. Truly, a visionary.
Fine. Barely useful. Progress.
Big one. Head office hears my name.
A pearl. Past the tether. Ask nicely.
Greed is heavy. Winch, genius.
Too heavy. Drop it or winch. Now.
End of the rope. Turn around.
Winching. Look like cargo.
My patience is thinning. Find something shiny.
Patience is nearly gone. Move it, diver.
Almost out. Salvage. Now.
Hand on the cutter. Hurry.
Snip. Head office sends regards.
Company policy. Swim, moron.
Finally, a request I can grant.
Cutting you loose. Your idea, remember.
Cut it. The hull costs more.
Air is almost gone. Move.
Almost out of air. SWIM, you idiot.
Made it. I lost a bet.
Out of air. Written off. Invoice to the estate.
Not personal. It was hungry. You were there.
Diver eaten. Logged as wear and tear.
Replacement diver. Same idiot, new lungs.
New diver. Do not get attached. I never do.
Read the receipt. My cut is the big one. Not my fault.
Strong dive. I took my cut. You are welcome.
That is what is left after my cut. Congratulations on being poor.
My cut of nothing. Taken on principle.
It heard you. Stay quiet.
It is close. Lamp up.
Closing in. Lamp, idiot.
Lamp. LAMP.
It backed off. Do not get comfortable.
It has the tether! Lamp! LAMP!
It is chewing the tether. Lamp on it.
Lamp. Now. Or I cut.
There. The relic. I have already spent it.
You got it. Almost impressed. Almost.
Winch it. Everything down here hears.
Relic banked. My cut of priceless is priceless.
Your only shot. Statistically, you will waste it.
You shot the sub. Your tab.
Rock. Well done.
It flinched. Do not get used to it.
Missed. The ocean is big. Even you.
Click. Nothing loaded. Genius.
Wall! The hull is not free, genius.
Easy! That is my hull.
Hull is cracking. Any more and we die.
Breach. Hull gone. You are a write-off, diver.
Sonar contact. Something big. Moving.
